title: qa-gate AI evidence (qa-report/ai-eval-latest.json)
description: What a project reports about the behaviour of its own AI. The gate never runs a model; it reads this file, exactly as it reads a coverage report. Produce it with any runner — vitest, promptfoo, a script. Cases, not percentages: the gate derives its own aggregates so that a case which used to pass cannot start failing while an average rises.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601. Compared against the newest commit touching ai.promptGlobs: older evidence than the prompt it measured is stale.

runner.description: Free text: vitest, promptfoo, script — for the record, not for the verdict.

model.description: The exact model the cases ran against, ideally a dated snapshot.

promptFiles.description: Prompt files these cases exercise; recorded in the evidence bundle.

id.description: Stable across runs — it is the unit the ratchet remembers.

category.description: safety = harm to a person (an allergy captured, an exclusion preserved) · security = injection, exfiltration · quality = is the answer useful. safety and security must be 100%; quality ratchets.

detail.description: One line for a human; it reaches the report and the SARIF message.

input.description: Optional. Never put customer data here — the file is committed.
